meta_description: Goat cheese stuffed aubergine with spiced walnuts and chevre — a Pakistani-French fusion that works beautifully as a starter or vegetarian main. 145 chars.
og_title: Goat Cheese Stuffed Aubergine with Walnuts
og_description: Baby aubergines filled with toasted walnuts, cumin, chilli, and warm French chevre. A Pakistani-French fusion that earns its place on any table — vegetarian, halal, and genuinely interesting.

image_briefs.prompt: Eight roasted baby aubergines fanned open on a white ceramic serving plate, filled with golden-brown spiced walnut mixture and melted white chevre, finished with a dark glossy drizzle of pomegranate molasses and fresh coriander leaves. Warm side lighting, dark slate surface, shallow depth of field.
image_briefs.alt: Goat cheese stuffed aubergine with spiced walnuts and pomegranate molasses on a white ceramic plate

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay of raw baby aubergines, a log of fresh chevre, walnut halves, a small red onion, green chilli, lemon, and small bowls of cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika arranged on a dark linen cloth. Natural daylight.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for goat cheese stuffed aubergine including chevre, walnuts, baby aubergines, and whole spices

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up overhead of a partially roasted baby aubergine being pressed open with two thumbs to reveal a scored cross cavity, ready for filling, on a parchment-lined dark baking tray. Slightly blistered skin visible.
image_briefs.alt: Baby aubergine pressed open in cross pattern ready to be filled with walnut and chevre mixture

image_briefs.prompt: Two finished goat cheese stuffed aubergines on a small white side plate, cross-section visible showing layers of melted chevre and spiced walnut filling inside the collapsed smoky flesh.
